# Helen Mulder OT

Personal writing by Helen Mulder, Occupational Therapist, on practical dementia care and neuro-metabolic rehabilitation.

## Articles

- [Constipation Prevention for Dementia](https://helenmulder.com/healthy-gut-healthy-brain/published_article.html): Dementia-friendly strategies for bowel regularity.
- [Oral Health for Dementia - Beyond Brushing](https://helenmulder.com/gum_disease_alzheimers_link/published_article.html): Maintaining a tolerable oral health routine for dementia.
- [Immune Drain](https://helenmulder.com/immune-drain/published_article.html): How recurring infections and chronic local inflammation can burden an already stressed system.
- [UTI Prevention for Dementia](https://helenmulder.com/uti-prevention-for-dementia/published_article.html): Practical strategies to reduce urinary tract infection risk in dementia care.
